title: List of Outcomes: State Visit of President of the Swiss Confederation to India
body_text:
I. MoU/ LoI/ Agreement
S.No Expected Deliverable Description 1. MoU on Migration and Mobility Partnership (MMP) The MoU aims to develop migration and mobility cooperation under equal treatment principles, and to prevent and combat irregular migration/human exploitation/trafficking in accordance with national laws. It provides for multiple-entry visas for upto 5 years, including stays of upto 6 months on each visit, and renewable 1-year student permits. 2. Agreement on the Exchange of Young Professionals (YPS) The Agreement aims to govern the exchange of young professionals taking up temporary employment in the other country to enhance their professional and language skills within their field. YPS incorporates exchange of 300 persons annually per country, which may increase to 500, and a timeline of 30/90 days for verification of nationality/residency status, among other provisions. 3. MoU on Promotion and Collaboration on Transportation Technologies, Mobility Systems and Infrastructure in Identified Areas between the Federal Department of Economic Affairs, Education and Research (EAER) and Ministry of Road Transport & Highways The MoU aims to promote collaboration in sustainable infrastructure development, with a focus on transportation and mobility systems by advancing technologies and infrastructure in areas such as electric vehicles, ropeways, circular economy, tunnels, and other transport sectors. 4. Letter of Intent (LoI) between Department of Science and Technology (DST) and Swiss National           Science Foundation (SNSF) The LoI aims to promote long-term cooperation between the Indian and Swiss research communities by supporting exploratory scientific collaboration, building partnerships for future joint research, and establishing a broader framework to sustain long-term initiatives across mutually agreed priority areas. 5. Implementation Arrangement (IA) for cooperation in Innovation, Technology Transfer and Entrepreneurship between Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Zurich University of Applied Sciences The IA aims to establish bilateral cooperation in innovation, technology transfer, and entrepreneurship by implementing the Indo–Swiss Academia–Industry Training (AIT India) program for early-stage startups through bilateral exchange, joint workshops, capability building, and networking.
II. Announcements
S.No Announcement Inaugural session of Indo-Swiss Research Flagship event in collaboration with Ministry of Science and Technology
